answered.sql: SELECT W Vineyards.Name, T.Type FROM Wine_Regions AS V Vineyards JOIN Wine_Regions_Winery_Tours AS WRT ON V Vineyards.RegionID = WRT.WineRegionID JOIN Winery_Tours AS T ON WRT.TourType = T.Type

candidates.meaning: Show the wine regions and the types of tours they offer
candidates.sql: SELECT W.Name, WT.Type FROM Wine_Regions W JOIN Wine_Regions_Winery_Tours WRT ON W.RegionID = WRT.WineRegionID JOIN Winery_Tours WT ON WRT.TourType = WT.Type

candidates.meaning: Show the tours available in each wine region.
candidates.sql: SELECT WRT.WineRegionID, WT.Type FROM Wine_Regions_Winery_Tours AS WRT JOIN Winery_Tours AS WT ON WRT.TourType = WT.Type

candidates.meaning: List the tour types offered by each wine region.
candidates.sql: SELECT WRT.WineRegionID, WRT.TourType FROM Wine_Regions_Winery_Tours AS WRT

candidates.meaning: Display the tour types and their durations for each wine region.
candidates.sql: SELECT WRT.WineRegionID, WT.Type, WT.Duration FROM Wine_Regions_Winery_Tours AS WRT JOIN Winery_Tours AS WT ON WRT.TourType = WT.Type
